title: Least-Privilege & Tiered Autonomy
summary: Define autonomy levels by risk, implement human-in-the-loop workflows, enforce least-privilege access, block policy violations, and design complete accountability systems.

blocks.text: **Per-Invocation Scoping:** Each agent invocation receives ONLY the permissions required for that specific task at that moment. No pre-provisioned broad access.

**Tiered Autonomy Pattern (Exam Favourite):** Full agent autonomy on feature branches + required human approval gate at merge to main/release. Maximum velocity in low-risk zones; mandatory gate at the critical boundary.
**Official Study Guide Quote:** "Preserve execution velocity by minimising approvals that do not materially reduce risk." Every gate must be justified by the specific risk it mitigates.
